document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You find no secret door, though you do see twelve fine grooves. 
You begin to get nervous. Best to get out, you think. Well, make 
a successful Jump or Climb roll and you emerge back at 428. 
Otherwise, a panel slides across the top, sealing you in. If you 
don’t have a light, you never see the twelve razor-sharp blades 
which snap out of the grooves, cutting you into as many pieces 
but, light or not, it is ... THE END.
(428, 430)
